description: A pointer to a corresponding record in a foreign/external system -- a trimmed-down FHIR Identifier (the 20% of that spec covering 80% of real needs): system + id (or a direct url) identifying where the record lives. This is an IDENTIFIER, not a metadata bucket -- it exists to replace ad-hoc stripeId/shopifyOrderId-style fields scattered across schemas with one uniform shape. Consumers attach zero or more of these via an externalReferences array on the owning entity instead of growing bespoke per-integration fields. Requires (system AND id) OR url -- a reference must be resolvable by API (system+id), by browser (url), or both.

$kind.description: Optional self-identifier (cf. GraphQL __typename). Omit when the enclosing schema already names the role -- e.g. an entry inside an externalReferences array is unambiguously an external-reference by virtue of the array it lives in, so $kind adds nothing there. Include only when this object might appear untyped outside its normal context.

id.description: The identifier of the corresponding record in the foreign system, opaque to this schema (a Stripe customer id, a Shopify order number, a Salesforce record Id, etc.). Required together with system when url is absent.

label.description: Short human-readable label for display, e.g. "Stripe customer" or "View in Salesforce". Optional -- consumers may fall back to system when absent.

publiclyAccessible.description: Whether url can be dereferenced without authentication. Absent means unknown -- do not assume false. True marks links safe to expose directly to end users (e.g. a public tracking page); false or absent means the link requires the viewer to be authenticated in the foreign system (e.g. an internal Stripe dashboard URL).

system.description: Open-vocabulary identifier of the foreign system, e.g. "stripe", "shopify", "salesforce", or a URI for systems without a common short name. Not a closed enum -- new integrations should not require a schema change.

url.description: A dereferenceable URL for the record in the foreign system, when one exists (a Stripe dashboard link, a Salesforce record URL, a public tracking page). Required when system and id are absent.

title: External reference
